{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured blazer in a classic navy weave, tailored fit with notched lapels, knee-length hem, deep midnight blue (#0B132B), heavy wool blend.  
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in matte charcoal, relaxed cut falling just below the ankle, mid-calf length, rich charcoal gray (#36454F), cotton twill.  
Strapless pumps with a 7 cm heel, pointed toe and sleek silhouette, glossy black finish (#000000), patent leather.  
Thin gold chain necklace, small stud earrings, and a compact clutch in metallic bronze, delicate links, polished metal, lightweight brushed steel.  

This outfit balances the need to stay cool while moving through a crowded club with breathable yet structured fabrics that resist wrinkling during long walks. The classic navy and charcoal palette keeps the look refined and timeless against the chaotic energy of a rock concert, allowing her to feel confident without blending into the background. Heeled pumps provide an elevated posture suited for an evening event, while the single-layer ensemble respects the warm artificial lighting and lack of need for outerwear on a mild autumn night."}
